title: 第405章 得了脏病
slug: 离婚当天前夫小叔连夜抢我领证
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

田小娥咬着牙忍了好几天，实在熬不住了，才敢跟方安雅开口。

方安雅看她那副难受的样子，还以为是上火。

年轻人火气旺，加上这段时间天天吃肉，缺了蔬菜水果，身体扛不住也是常事。

她没多想，带着田小娥去了附近的医院。

这不看不知道，一看，方安雅吓得心脏病都快犯了。

“病人感染了梅毒，二期。”

“从症状来看，感染时间应该在一个月到两个月之间。这种情况需要立即住院治疗，否则发展到三期会影响到神经系统和心血管系统，到时候就麻烦了。”

方安雅从医生手里接过报告单，手指哆嗦得跟秋风里的树叶似的。

这两个字说出口都嫌脏。

方安雅脑子嗡嗡的，第一个反应不是恶心，是害怕。

她跟田小娥同吃同住了大半个月，用的同一个厨房，吃的同一锅饭，田小娥用过的碗筷是她洗的，田小娥坐过的沙发是她擦的，万一传染上了怎么办？

方安雅哆嗦着，赶紧给林见微打了电话。

林见微听到电话那头母亲的声音不对，心里一紧，立马就赶了过来。

到的时候，方安雅正坐在医院门口的花坛边沿上，脸色灰白。

林见微快步走过去。

“田小娥她、她竟然得了那种病……梅毒……我……”

方安雅说到最后已经说不下去了，胃里翻涌着一阵阵恶心。

林见微从兜里掏出一颗中级修复丸塞到方安雅手里，“妈，你先把这个药吃了，防止感染。”

方安雅连忙吞下药丸，声音发颤：“微微，万一阿轩真和她有过接触，会不会也染上病？”

“我已经给二哥打了电话，让他等会儿来医院，一起检查一下。”

话音刚落，林秉轩就赶到了。

Page (1/3)

Tian Xiao'e gritted her teeth and endured it for several days. Only when she couldn't stand it anymore did she dare to speak to Fang Anya.

Seeing her uncomfortable look, Fang Anya thought she was angry.

Young people are very angry. In addition, during this period of time, they eat meat every day. It is common for the body to be unable to bear the lack of vegetables and fruits.

She didn't think much and took Tian Xiao'e to a nearby hospital.

You don't know this, but Fang Anya was so frightened that she almost had a heart attack.

"The patient is infected with syphilis, stage two."

"Judging from the symptoms, the infection time should be between one month and two months. This situation requires immediate hospitalization, otherwise it will affect the nervous system and cardiovascular system when it develops to the third stage, and then it will be troublesome."

Fang Anya took the report from the doctor, her fingers trembling like leaves in the autumn wind.

These two words are dirty to say.

Fang Anya's mind was buzzing, and her first reaction was not nausea, but fear.

She and Tian Xiao'e lived together for more than half a month. They used the same kitchen and ate from the same pot of rice. She washed the dishes and chopsticks that Tian Xiao'e used and she wiped the sofa that Tian Xiao'e sat on. What if she got infected?

Fang Anya trembled and quickly called Lin Jianwei.

When Lin Jianwei heard something was wrong with her mother's voice on the other end of the phone, her heart tightened and she rushed over immediately.

When they arrived, Fang Anya was sitting on the edge of the flower bed in front of the hospital, her face ashen.

Lin Jianwei walked over quickly.

"Tian Xiao'e, she actually got that disease... syphilis... I..."

Fang Anya couldn't speak anymore at the end, feeling nausea surging in her stomach.

Lin Jianwei took out an intermediate repair pill from his pocket and stuffed it into Fang Anya's hand, "Mom, take this medicine first to prevent infection."

Fang Anya quickly swallowed the pills, her voice trembling: "Wei Wei, if A Xuan really comes into contact with her, will he also contract the disease?"

"I have already called my second brother and asked him to come to the hospital later for a checkup together."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Bingxuan arrived.
